what: How much each design element's z-score moves when the SAME garment is photographed on a model instead of as a flat lay. Used to mark which elements of an uploaded photo's profile can be trusted.

source.dataset: DeepFashion-InShop (Marqo/deepfashion-inshop mirror, offline evaluation only, no licence stated)
source.pairs: 150 garments x 15 elements, _1_front (on model) vs _6_flat (flat lay)

overall.control_same_domain: unavailable: no garment in the sample has two flat photos, so the domain cost cannot be separated from the task difficulty

caveat: Both presentations are retailer photography of the same garment. A real customer upload (phone camera, room lighting, crop, other garments in frame) is a larger shift, so these numbers are a LOWER bound on the instability.
